recommendation: Keep the source fix as-is; it completes the applied FHIR-12806 Distance binding without reopening imperial units or duplicating FHIR-40607 duration-display work.
issue_request: FHIR-12806 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for DSTU2 and requested actual unit bindings for Quantity-derived Age, Duration, and Distance constraints: extensible bindings to common units and maximum value sets defined by UCUM canonical properties, with imperial distance units excluded.
initial_application: Commit 61ad12d35fc9ba1cbb1c1905840dacd7d3f46861, imported from svn revision 12715 with subject '#12806 - bindings on quantity variations', added the datatype bindings and value sets. Age and Duration were bound to common/max time unit sets and Distance was bound to common/max distance unit sets, but the common Distance value set omitted cm even though the accepted metric scope retained it.
additional_context: Distance is an active datatype and DistanceUnits is an extensible binding to valueset-distance-units with maximum valueset-all-distance-units. The maximum distance value set already uses canonical=m. Later FHIR-40607 work, already represented on the combined branch, corrected Duration display/all-time behavior but did not alter the Distance metric common-unit scope. Jira, Zulip, Confluence, and git searches found no later decision intentionally excluding cm.
reconciliation: Added <code value="cm"/> with display "centimeters" to source/datatypes/valueset-distance-units.xml, preserving the existing metric-only Distance unit list and leaving Age, Duration, and maximum canonical-filter bindings unchanged.
source_changes: source/datatypes/valueset-distance-units.xml: added UCUM code cm with display centimeters to Common UCUM Codes for Distance.
